description.en_us: Automatically download photos and videos from iCloud to your server. Supports multiple accounts, selective sync, and automatic authentication. Install 'iCloudPD Manager' for easy configuration through a web interface.

before_install.en_us:
⚠️ Important: This app requires manual authentication setup. For easier management, install 'iCloudPD Manager' from YizAppStore.

You'll need:
• Your Apple ID credentials
• Two-factor authentication enabled on your Apple account
• A folder to store downloaded photos

Recommended: Install 'iCloudPD Manager' for a user-friendly web interface to manage your iCloud accounts and authentication.
